summary.text: Mike Moser is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 22, and was elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Mike Moser's occupation as owner and manager of Columbus Music Company.

paragraphs.text: Mike Moser was born on September 18, 1951, in Fremont.

Mike Moser graduated from Scotus Central Catholic High School in 1969, earned an associate degree from Central Community College in 1971, and earned a B.A. from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln in 1975.
Mike Moser served as mayor of Columbus from 2004 to 2016 and on the Nebraska Crime Commission from 2007 to 2010.
Mike Moser is a member of St. Isidore Catholic Church.
Mike Moser married Jan Waak in 1971, and they have three children.
